title: It works ok
text: It works ok. I say it works ok, it make one big stuffed hamburger. And I do mean BIG. It will be fun trying new stuffing of it!

product_metadata.title: Charcoal Companion CC5119 Stuff-a-Burger Press
features: Stuff burgers with fillings by your design
Made of durable plastic that is dishwasher safe
Makes a functional yet quirky gift for any griller or cook
description: Designed to hold an impressive 3/4-pound of ground meat, the Stuff-A-Burger Press can be filled with an infinite variety of flavor combinations. Try it with garted cheese, grilled onions or mushrooms.
